results.text: Clinical pharmacokinetics of glipizide: a systematic review. Glipizide is an oral antidiabetic drug widely used to treat non-insulin-dependent type II diabetes mellitus (NIDDM). This systematic review extensively examines all reported pharmacokinetic (PK) parameters of glipizide in healthy and diseased populations.
